notes.title: Demo Update to UE5.5
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 
first of all, thank you very much for your patience and support while the game release got delayed. We've pushed the release date from Q2 to Q3 to take some extra time on optimisation and improve the overall performance of the game. To do that, we updated the game to UE5.5 and improved utilisation of RAM, GPU, CPU. Please let us know how the demo runs on your machines! While exploring the demo again, you'll find some smaller and some bigger added details to the world. Owners of NVIDIA, AMD, intel cards can now experience DLSS, FSR, XeSS upscaling for great details and reduced impact on overall performance at high resolutions. We hope you enjoy it!
